name: The E2E NLG Challenge Dataset
description: The E2E NLG Challenge Dataset is a crowdsourced data-to-text natural language generation benchmark developed at Heriot-Watt University (Novikova et al., SIGDIAL 2017). Designed for training and evaluating end-to-end NLG systems in the restaurant domain, the dataset provides 51,426 diverse natural language utterances mapped to structured meaning representations (attribute-value pairs including name, food type, price range, customer rating, area, family-friendliness, and near-by landmarks). It contains 42,061 training, 4,672 validation, and 4,693 test samples.
